Name: Honest Run
Description: Win a jam with zero sockpuppets. The rarest outcome in the genre.

Name: Night Owl
Description: Hold SHIFT for a total of one minute in a single run.

Name: Snowball
Description: Flip one hub and watch at least ten voters follow on their own.

Name: Banned Speedrun
Description: Get disqualified before the jam is a third of the way through.

Name: Best Game, Worst Rank
Description: Finish with a top-three quality rank and a vote rank of seventh or worse.

Name: Shifted the Blame
Description: Use Shift the Blame and hand the rival a strike. Classic.

Name: Gate Crasher
Description: Slip past a locked hub with SHIFT. Do not mention it to the mods.

Name: Audience Capture
Description: Flip a celebrity because their own followers backed you first.

Name: Giant Slayer
Description: Win the final jam against the biggest rival there is.

Name: Streamer's Pet
Description: Get featured by a streamer. Be gracious. Be quick.

Name: Eye Contact
Description: Get caught by the Mod Eye with your Heat in the red.

Name: Sticky Situation
Description: Toggle night with the N key instead of holding SHIFT.

Name: Schadenfreude
Description: Win after your rival collapses. Technically not your fault.

Name: Nobody Played It
Description: Win with a bottom-three quality rank. Nobody played it. Everybody voted.
